guard: gate-inventory roots are what CI actually runs, and a live suite dropped from that chain is named as ungated
why: Treating `check` as a root made every suite reachable only from that developer chain look gated.
The inventory then printed OK whether CI ran those suites or not. Removing `check` from ROOTS is the
instrument repair; putting the revealed live suites on the live job is the coverage repair.
Dropping one of those newly added live invocations must redden the inventory on that suite name.
The find is the live-job chain fragment, not a comment and not a call signature.

mutations.name: drop join-external:live from the live job so a check-only suite looks gated again
mutations.find: pnpm smoke:dogfood:live && pnpm smoke:join-external:live && pnpm smoke:backup-perms:live
